mapper.sql:
from user as a where 1=1 AND 1 = #{shUseNy} AND a.user_delny = #{shDelNy}
AND a.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{shValue},'%') AND a.gender LIKE CONCAT('%',#{shValue},'%') AND a.email LIKE CONCAT('%',#{shValue},'%')
mapper.select:
select aa.* from ( select a.user_id, a.name, a.gender, a.birthday, a.clearance, a.id, a.email, a.password, a.address, a.user_delny
ORDER BY a.user_id desc )aa limit #{startRnumForMysql}, #{rowNumToShow}
select a.user_id, a.name, a.gender, a.birthday, a.clearance, a.id, a.email, a.password, a.address, a.user_delny from user a where a.user_id = #{user_id} ORDER BY a.user_id desc
mapper.insert:
insert into user( user_id, name, gender, birthday, clearance, id, email, password, address, user_delny )values( #{user_id}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{birthday}, #{clearance}, #{id}, #{email}, #{password}, #{address}, #{user_delny} )
Select last_insert_id()
mapper.update: update user set name = #{name}, gender = #{gender}, id = #{id}, birthday = #{birthday}, clearance = #{clearance}, email = #{email}, password = #{password}, address = #{address}, user_delny = #{user_delny} where user_id =#{user_id}
